title: Car assets for events and characters.

posts.author: Arr222
posts.body:
Greetings and salutations, wisemen and women of "RPGMaker" forums! I wish to ask for your wisdom.
I am looking for big cars, that could be used in events or characters, since any assets I find are mostly made as tilesets, rather than something meant to be used in place of characters.
I thank you in advance for all the answers.
